comments.value:
The fallback system is great but not perfect and it's still falling short of it's potential to mend this Frankenstein VR Community where phone VR was mended to PCVR and a guy said "It's fine."  "Nope"
Seriously though, get fallbacks right and it will give users a convenient options between two or more acceptable options.  A quality torso and head and hands avatar is better than the hit or miss of current fallbacks and anyone who disagrees is welcome to use an existing fallback as their main avatar.  No harm done.
True story: With a good host, Karaoke in Big Screen is leagues better than it is in VRC Karaoke worlds.  When I say their avatars are simple but solid, it is from experience.  No I would never want VRC to only have those avatars, but as a fallback system It would put the fork into this part of the crossplay challenge.

details:
The Good Quest rating requirements are too impractical for humanoid models of reasonable quality and definitely do not allow for creative variety as not a single tri can be squandered.
If VRChat just truly can't stretch that at all then perhaps instead of fallback avatars they should have a fallback avatar system.  Big Screen Avatars actually are fun to use.  Unique looks are possible, the eye movement and visemes and quality faces are all great and fun socially.
More than that, the avatar content exists on local machines.  They are way better than Robots and hair brushes and sticks of butter and deformed humanoids.
Let users customize their image for the fall back avatar system.  Then it will be clear at a glance who's avatars are shown, but every player can be interacted with enjoyably if a person elects not to show their traditional VRC avatar.  All this with less server space wasted and without taking hours of peoples lives wrestling out ugly fallbacks from their works of art.
